course.name: Distributed Systems
course.status: Published official course home, schedule, linked notes and assignment descriptions observed; schedule itself is labelled tentative.
course.prerequisites: 6.1910 (6.004) and one of 6.1800 (6.033) or 6.1810, or equivalent; substantial programming experience helpful.
course.public_materials: Home, schedule, selected lecture notes, paper links and lab descriptions are publicly readable without course registration.
course.registration_and_fees: Public reading is separate from MIT enrollment, grading, check-offs and credit. This resource index does not establish enrollment eligibility, tuition, free certification or a public submission service.
course.reuse: No MIT assignment solutions, skeleton code or test harness are copied. These Lab exercises are independent originals, not answers to MIT labs.

units.practice_goal_en: Classify evidence without converting a timeout into an abort.
units.practice_goal_zh: 分类观测，不把超时转换成回滚。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Trace a transitive causal path and a concurrent pair; logical-clock supplement is Lamport 1978, not a dedicated MIT lecture claim.
units.practice_goal_zh: 追踪传递因果与并发对；逻辑时钟补充来自 Lamport 1978，不冒充 MIT 的独立讲次。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Compare real-time versus client-order constraints with an independent exhaustive oracle.
units.practice_goal_zh: 通过独立穷举 oracle 比较真实时间与客户端顺序约束。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Run real three-voter connection partitions; contrast a majority component and three singletons.
units.practice_goal_zh: 运行真实三投票节点连接分区，对照多数派分区与三个孤立节点。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Observe commit-before-response timeouts and atomically stored deduplication results.
units.practice_goal_zh: 观察先提交后超时，以及原子保存的去重结果。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Compare stale-generation writes after a real lease expires; Chubby §2.4 supplements the course.
units.practice_goal_zh: 真实租约过期后比较旧代次写；以 Chubby §2.4 补充课程。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

units.practice_goal_en: Check committed-value preservation, healed replicas and unknown outcomes from saved real reports.
units.practice_goal_zh: 核查保存真实报告中的已提交值、恢复副本与未知结果。
units.exercise_origin: Independent Distributed Systems Lab exercise, not an MIT solution

supplements.title: Time, Clocks, and the Ordering of Events in a Distributed System
supplements.role: Causality supplement; classic paper, not a 2026 new result

supplements.title: The Chubby lock service for loosely-coupled distributed systems
supplements.role: Sequencers and stale requests, §2.4; classic paper
